text:
anya: Heads-up — CI flapping on eval PRs again. Multiple GH Actions runs per push, some duplicate Buildkite jobs.
matt: saw that. looks like webhook retries + our dispatcher creates duplicate fanout.
kai: any logs? I can try to repro locally.
anya: here's the GH webhook delivery ids from yesterday: 12345, 12346 (retry). both triggered the same workflow run payload.
selena: ugh. and our PR gating expects exactly one artifact per commit so it fails the gate when there are duplicates.
ci-bot: buildkite: triggered pipeline "evals/nightly-smoke" for commit abcdef1 (from github actions)
matt: short-term fix: add a dispatcher check in the action that dedups on "github.event.client_payload.dispatch_id" or commit sha + head_ref before kicking Buildkite.
kai: can we do that purely in GH Actions? maybe a dedicated step that queries a small state store (S3 / redis) to see if seen.
selena: prefer not to add redis right now. simple file-based marker in the repo workspace won't survive concurrent runners.
anya: I prototyped an idempotency helper step:
```
- name: dedupe dispatch
  run: |
    echo "DISPATCH_ID=${{ github.event.delivery }}" >> /tmp/dispatch_id
    if aws s3api head-object --bucket rwd-ci-ids --key "${DISPATCH_ID}" 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "already processed" && exit 0
    fi
    aws s3 cp /dev/null s3://rwd-ci-ids/${DISPATCH_ID}
```
This avoids any extra infra but uses S3 head-object for existence check.
matt: neat. does S3 head-object have eventual consistency issues? might still race but much lower.
selena: also thought about switching triggers to `workflow_dispatch` from the dispatcher and have a single persistent runner do the fanout (no duplicates). Ops might not like single point but safer.
kai: alternative: in Buildkite step we can check Buildkite meta env for duplicate runs and auto-cancel duplicates using the Buildkite API. that keeps GH Actions simple.
anya: true. but some flakes happen earlier when the GH Action already posted gating artifact; duplicate artifact creation causes the report dashboard to show double counts. we need dedupe upstream.
ci-bot: github: workflow run 8975 cancelled (duplicate detection)
selena: long-term: make the eval runner idempotent and include a run_id in artifact metadata, then dashboard can collapse duplicates. metric: unique_run_id per artifact.
matt: agreed. for short-term let's add the S3-based dedupe step + a Buildkite cancel-on-duplicate hook. PR incoming.
anya: pinging @kai for review on the GH action step — I pushed branch `ci/dedupe-s3-step`.
kai: I'll review in ~20m. can we add unit tests to simulate webhook retry? simple GH Actions integration test in repo-sim maybe.
selena: add a smoke job that intentionally replays the webhook twice and assert single downstream artifact. small e2e.
anya: thanks. can we also add a dashboard alert for unusual duplicates (rate > 0.5% per hour) so we catch regressions?
matt: yes — I'll add a grafana alert on `evals.dispatch.duplicate_rate`. default threshold 0.5% for 1h.
ci-bot: buildkite: created patch build #321 for branch ci/dedupe-s3-step
anya: great. follow-up: we should document the idempotency approach in eng-ml runbook + add mention in onboarding for new eval runners. (reacted :white_check_mark:)
selena: note: security review for S3 bucket policy before merging. avoid public listing.
kai: good catch. I'll add a restrictive policy and KMS encryption.
matt: ok looks like consensus. I'll merge if builds pass and no objections by EOD.
anya: thanks all.
